# Getting help

- **Something does not work** — open an issue with the **Bug report** form. In the studios, **Settings → About → Report a problem** opens it with the version and your graphics card already filled in.
- **A question about how to do something** — use the **Question** form.
- **An idea** — use the **Idea** form; if the idea is already there, add a 👍 instead.
- **News and releases** — [@nerual_dreming on Telegram](https://t.me/nerual_dreming).

Write in any language — English, Русский, 中文.
